title: Render plain-text input verbatim
lead:
`quire` accepts only `.md` and `.markdown` targets and always parses them as
Markdown.
boundary:
**Not in this slice:** per-build font-size or margin flags (profiles and
`--css` set those); Pandoc option passthrough; changes to any external profile.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Fixed-width forms, invoices, and tables (the branded-pdf `-mono` wrapper's use
case) lose their column alignment when parsed as Markdown, and `.txt` targets
are rejected. Wrapping the file by hand in a fenced block works today but
breaks when the text itself contains a backtick fence. Profile CSS can already
style the result: a WeasyPrint named page (`.quire-verbatim { page: verbatim; }`
with `@page verbatim { margin: 0.7in; }`) gives verbatim pages their own
margins, so one profile covers prose and fixed-width documents without a
separate mono profile.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `quire.py` (target suffix check in `plan_job`, `prepare_markdown`, default
  output naming)
- `plain.css`, `plain-confidential.css`
- `test_quire.py`
- `README.md`, `docs/profiles.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A `.txt` target plans a job whose Markdown is one fenced code block inside
  `<div class="quire-verbatim">`, with the text unchanged.
- The fence is longer than the longest backtick run in the text, so a line of
  three backticks in the input stays inside the block.
- A leading `---` line is not read as YAML front matter.
- Profile includes and `--include-before` fragments are still prepended.
- The default output for `notes.txt` is `notes.pdf` (and `notes.html` with
  `--format html`); variant suffixes still apply.
- Other suffixes are still rejected with the existing error.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Accept `.txt` targets. In preparation, wrap the whole text in a backtick fence
one longer than its longest backtick run (minimum three), inside a
`quire-verbatim` div, and skip front-matter detection for that input; keep the
rest of the pipeline, including includes, variants, and suffixes, unchanged.
Mermaid rendering never applies because the block has no `mermaid` class.
In both plain stylesheets, style `.quire-verbatim pre` to keep lines unwrapped
at a smaller size (`white-space: pre; font-size: 9pt`). Document the class and
the named-page pattern in `docs/profiles.md`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `python3 test_quire.py`
- Real build of an 80-column `.txt` form with `--no-config` and with a profile
  that sets a named page, if the runtime is available; report whether the
  columns align and fit the page width.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: No commit unless the owner asks.
